content.title: Who am I?
content.description: I help companies navigate digital transformation. I started in sales and marketing before moving into engineering, so I read both sides: what's technically possible, and the organizational change that has to happen for it to land. My edge is that I don't only advise — I can build the thing too.

content.title: My Journey
content.description: I treat AI as an enabler, not a gimmick — a lever for rethinking how a business works, not just for shipping code faster. My focus stays on the decisions that matter: where technology creates real advantage, and how people actually adopt it.
